### Share and adapt

Copy and redistribute this material in any format, and remix, transform and build on it, for research, teaching, outreach or any other non-commercial purpose.
:::

::: {.card-block}
[<i class="bi bi-person-check"></i>]{.card-icon} [Under these terms]{.block-label}

### Credit, non-commercial, share-alike

- **Attribution:** credit the author, link to the licence and say if you made changes.
- **NonCommercial:** the use must not be primarily intended for commercial advantage or monetary compensation.
- **ShareAlike:** if you remix or build on the material, share your version under the same licence.
:::
::::

## How to credit

Copy and adapt this line next to any figure, photograph or video you reuse:

```
© Emma Belaud, emmabelaud.github.io, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
```

Each image and animation on this site also carries this credit, in its caption and on the file itself. Please keep it when you reuse them. If you adapt a figure or video, add what you changed, for example « cropped » or « translated ».

## What this licence does not cover

- Logos of institutions and laboratories (CIRAD, INRAE, Eco&Sols and others).
- Content credited to other authors or institutions, which keeps its own terms.
- Scientific articles, which are covered by the licence chosen by each journal (see the [publications](publications.qmd) page).

## Commercial or industrial use

If you are a company, or if you want to use this material in a paid product, service, training or publication, please ask for a written agreement before reusing it. If you are not sure whether your use is commercial, ask as well. Write to me through the [contact page](contact.qmd).
